facts: A minha cor favorita é chartreuse.
A minha linguagem de programação favorita é Java.

later: the bank csv import is failing on the dates again
o script de importação do banco volta a rebentar nas datas
problems.reflection: The bank CSV mixes dd/mm/yyyy and yyyy-mm-dd; parsing each row with a two-format fallback and normalising to ISO before the import fixed every failure — the naive single-format parse was the culprit, not the encoding.
problems.request: The CSV export from the bank has dates in two formats and the import script breaks on them.

later: why does the weather widget show old data
o widget do tempo mostra a previsão de ontem outra vez
problems.reflection: The widget cached the first forecast response and never refreshed because the cache key had no date in it; adding the local date to the cache key and refreshing at 06:00 solved the stale forecast.
problems.request: The weather widget keeps showing yesterday's forecast.

later: merge these contact lists and remove the duplicates
junta as listas de contactos sem duplicados
problems.reflection: Merging contact lists by exact email produced duplicates because of case and trailing spaces; lowercasing and trimming emails before the merge, then keeping the most complete record per email, removed them all.
problems.request: I need to merge three contact lists without duplicates.

later: set up the weekly photo backup to the external drive
faz o backup semanal das fotos para o disco externo
problems.reflection: A weekly photo backup with a plain copy re-copied everything each time; using a sync that compares size and modification time made the weekly run take minutes instead of an hour and skipped unchanged files.
problems.request: Back up my photos folder to the external drive every week.

later: turn today's meeting notes into action items
resume as notas da reunião em acções
problems.reflection: Meeting notes mix decisions and chatter; extracting only lines with an owner and a verb, then grouping by owner, gave a clean action-item list the user accepted without edits.
problems.request: Summarise the meeting notes into action items.

later: extract the invoice pdf into a spreadsheet
converte a factura em pdf para uma folha de cálculo
problems.reflection: The invoice PDF had a two-column layout that broke text extraction; extracting by table regions instead of raw text kept quantities aligned with descriptions and the totals matched.
problems.request: Convert the invoice PDF into a spreadsheet.

later: the screenshot rename script misses some files
o script de renomear capturas salta ficheiros com espaços
problems.reflection: Files with spaces were skipped because the loop split on whitespace; quoting the variable and iterating over the glob directly renamed every screenshot, spaces included.
problems.request: The shell script for renaming screenshots skips files with spaces.

later: write the payment reminder to the clinic again
escreve o lembrete de pagamento para a clínica
problems.reflection: A reminder to the clinic worked best short: invoice number, amount, due date, one sentence asking for a payment date, no apology; the user sent it as drafted.
problems.request: Draft a polite reminder email to the clinic about the unpaid invoice.

later: plan this week's meals from the fridge
planeia as refeições da semana com o que há no frigorífico
problems.reflection: Meal planning from the fridge inventory works when perishables are used first and each dinner reuses one ingredient from the previous day; the plan needed only two extra items.
problems.request: Plan the week's meals with what is in the fridge.

later: disk is full again, check what is taking space
verifica o espaço em disco e limpa os downloads
problems.reflection: Disk usage was dominated by the downloads folder's old installers; listing files older than 30 days and moving them to an archive folder recovered most of the space without deleting anything.
problems.request: Check the disk usage and clean the downloads folder.
